source: prototype gown_maker_v206.html (specs 9fed2db), captured headless: each scenario resets her numbers to the default figure and the given set, then moves the Waist / Hips sliders by dispatching their input events, reading current.vals, current.hipWant and the toast after each move. The toast is not cleared between moves, so a stale line carries over; the port returns the line only on the move that stopped the waist.

steps.note: The waist stops at 60 cm: her hips are 100 cm, and a waist under 6/10 of the hips is outside what the mannequin can shape. Change her hips first to go lower.
